answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 32419 Country: India Title: My husbands business was going in a smooth track but from last two years we are suffering from severe financial crisis and debt. Question: My husbands business was going in a smooth track but from last two years we are suffering from severe financial crisis and debt. We do every possible dua and khatams to get out of this problem but Allah seems to be angry with us.We recite Astagfar , Darood Ibrahim and Surah muzzamil as much as possible.You suggest a wazifa and remember us in your special duas . May Allah give you jazaiye Khair. Can business crisis be due to evil`s eye ? Please reply as soon as possible ,i am suffering from severe depression . Answer ID: 32419 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 873/721/B=1432) You should recite the following dua 100-100 times with durood 3-3 times before and after in the evening and morning: اللهم اكفنى بحلالك عن حرامك واغننى بفضلك عمن سواك . Then, it is hoped that your business shall start running smoothly again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
